svg.title: The Complex s-Plane: Critical Strip, Critical Line, and Zeros of ζ(s)
svg.desc: Coordinate diagram of the complex s-plane for Re(s) from −7 to 3.5 and Im(s) from −28 to 28. Three pattern- and border-distinguished regions are shown: the convergence half-plane Re(s) > 1 in soft blue with diagonal hatching and dashed boundary at Re(s) = 1; the critical strip 0 < Re(s) < 1 in soft amber with opposing diagonal hatching bounded by dashed lines at Re(s) = 0 and Re(s) = 1; and the bold solid cobalt critical line at Re(s) = 1/2. Plotted features include the simple pole at s = 1, trivial zeros at s = −2, −4, −6 on the real axis, the first three conjugate pairs of non-trivial zeros at 1/2 ± 14.13i, 1/2 ± 21.02i, and 1/2 ± 25.01i on the critical line, and a symmetry arrow marking the functional-equation reflection s ↔ 1 − s across Re(s) = 1/2.

text.font-family: Georgia, Cambria, 'Times New Roman', serif
